packageRules.description: An upstream image bump is a fix, so release-please releases it, and the images lock records the new upstream version (JorisJonkers-dev/workspace#140).
A seerr minor or patch release merges once Pipeline Complete passes, and release-please releases it.
A seerr major release waits for approval on the Dependency Dashboard.
A digest moved under the same tag is no new version, so it cannot be released.
